# Mentality Jiu Jitsu

> Beginner-friendly Brazilian Jiu Jitsu (Gi and No-Gi), Kids Jiu Jitsu and Muay Thai gym at 7/23 Corporation Circuit, Tweed Heads South NSW 2486, Australia. New members get three free classes with no card required. Founded and head-coached by black belt William Moraes.

## Key facts
- Location: 7/23 Corporation Cct, Tweed Heads South NSW 2486, Australia (on the NSW/QLD border, southern Gold Coast)
- Areas served: Tweed Heads, Banora Point, Terranora, Kingscliff, Murwillumbah, Coolangatta, Kirra, Bilinga, Tugun, Currumbin, Palm Beach
- Phone: +61 452 518 690
- Email: mentalityjiujitsu@outlook.com
- Free trial: three free classes, no card required, no obligation. Book at https://mentality-jiu-jitsu.gymdesk.com/signup
- Ongoing membership: $55–60 AUD per week; a no lock-in option is available
- Programs: Brazilian Jiu Jitsu for adults 16+ (Gi and No-Gi), Kids Jiu Jitsu (ages 4–7 and 8–14, taught separately), Muay Thai for adults 16+
- Beginners: no experience or fitness needed; adult classes include people from their late teens to their fifties. Sparring is always optional and never on day one.
- What to bring to a first class: shorts, a t-shirt and a water bottle. Loan gear is available; a gi is not needed for the trial.
- Parking: on-site and free
- Rating: 5.0 from 38 Google reviews
- Coaches: William Moraes (Founder & Head Coach; BJJ black belt under Professor Vicente Cavalcanti; Queensland State and NAGA champion), Zac O'Brien (Muay Thai coach)

## What members and parents say (Google reviews)
- "My son and I both train at Mentality. It's an amazing environment for both kids and adults. The coaches are great and super helpful with students of all abilities." — Jason C.
- "My kids love going there every week. The coaches are brilliant — not only highly skilled, but incredibly supportive and patient with the children." — Sasha B.
- "The instructors are not only highly skilled and experienced, but they also create a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone—beginners and advanced practitioners alike." — Victor E.
- "Clean and fresh facilities, including not just the BJJ and Muay Thai, but also great work out area." — Ricardo P.
More reviews: https://mentalityjiujitsu.com/reviews/

## Weekly class schedule
Times can change for public holidays; the live schedule is on Gymdesk (https://mentality-jiu-jitsu.gymdesk.com/).
- Monday: 3:45 – 4:30 pm Kids BJJ (Ages 4–7); 4:30 – 5:15 pm Kids BJJ (Ages 8–14); 5:30 – 6:30 pm BJJ Gi (Adults · all levels); 6:30 – 7:30 pm Muay Thai (Adults · all levels)
- Tuesday: 12:00 – 1:00 pm BJJ No Gi (Adults · lunchtime); 3:45 – 4:30 pm Kids BJJ (Ages 4–7); 4:30 – 5:15 pm Kids BJJ (Ages 8–14); 5:30 – 6:30 pm Muay Thai (Adults · all levels); 6:30 – 7:30 pm BJJ No Gi (Adults · all levels)
- Wednesday: 3:45 – 4:30 pm Kids BJJ No Gi (Ages 4–7); 4:30 – 5:15 pm Kids BJJ No Gi (Ages 8–14); 5:30 – 6:30 pm BJJ Gi (Adults · all levels)
- Thursday: 12:00 – 1:00 pm BJJ Gi (Adults · lunchtime); 3:45 – 4:30 pm Kids BJJ (Ages 4–7); 4:30 – 5:15 pm Kids BJJ (Ages 8–14); 5:30 – 6:30 pm Muay Thai (Adults · all levels); 6:30 – 7:30 pm BJJ No Gi (Adults · all levels)
- Friday: 5:00 – 6:00 pm BJJ Gi (Adults · all levels); 6:00 – 7:00 pm Open Mat (All members)
- Saturday: 8:30 – 9:15 am Kids BJJ Gi (Ages 4–7); 9:15 – 10:00 am Kids BJJ (Ages 8–14); 10:00 – 11:00 am Open Mat (All members)
- Sunday: no classes
